CVE-2026-129483.title: Cyrus SASL through 2.1.28 contains an authentication bypass vulne ...
CVE-2026-129483.description: Cyrus SASL through 2.1.28 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SRP server mechanism because srp_server_mech_step2 does not reject client public values A that are multiples of N. Unauthenticated network clients can send A equal to N to force a zero shared secret, authenticating as any existing user without the password and learning session keys.

CVE-2026-132138.title: A flaw was found in cyrus-sasl. When processing authentication re ...
CVE-2026-132138.description: A flaw was found in cyrus-sasl. When processing authentication requests using the Salted Challenge Response Authentication Mechanism (SCRAM), a remote attacker can trigger a null pointer dereference by submitting unexpected channel-binding data. This causes the server process to crash before validating authentication proofs, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).
